subject: Operations
title: Competing on Flexibility
description: A fast breakdown of Competing on Flexibility for builders.

hook.text: Zara launches 20 new clothing lines a year. Traditional brands manage 4. Flexibility is Zara's secret weapon.

buildup.text: Flexibility means quickly adapting to changes in product mix, volume, or design without major cost or time penalties.

discovery.text: There are two types: product flexibility (new designs fast) and volume flexibility (scaling up or down easily).

twist.text: Flexibility often conflicts with efficiency. Dedicated lines are efficient but rigid. Flexible lines cost more per unit.

climax.text: Tesla's gigafactories use programmable robots that switch between models—flexibility built into the factory design.

punchline.text: The most flexible company wins in uncertain markets.

quiz.question: What is volume flexibility?
options: Scaling production up or down easily
